items.text: Justin Jefferson listed OUT for Sunday with ankle sprain; Jordan Addison becomes primary beneficiary in home matchup vs weak secondary.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Schefter/Rapoport confirm sprained ankle.
items.implication: Addison elevated to WR1 opportunity; Vikings pass game volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Addison target/route share spike home vs borderline secondary

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dallas Goedert OUT vs Rams; Eagles missing three key pieces including Baun, offense downgraded.
items.why: ETR list and Schefter confirmation of hamstring/knee.
items.implication: Hurts and remaining WRs/TE face tougher efficiency; reverse any prior Smith/Goedert starts.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining Eagles pass-catchers if any healthy

items.text: Puka Nacua IN (hip/groin); expected to play though possible snap limits per speculation.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter notes expected to play, Donald OUT helps OL matchup somewhat.
items.implication: WR1 back in lineup; monitor for limits but startable.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if unlimited; reverse any Nacua-out beneficiaries

items.text: Nico Collins IN (hamstring) vs Cowboys; elite DvP spot as DAL inflates WR scoring most in NFL.
items.why: ETR IN; Rapoport 'good to go'; Texans high implied points.
items.implication: Elite WR play vs softest WR DvP; high start priority.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad); Jets RBs elevated with AD Mitchell also out.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup RBs see full workload; Wilson target share may rise further.
items.opportunity: Jets RB committee or lead back snaps/carries spike

items.text: Nacua return great but watch possible snap limits; Collins elite return spot (DAL +7.3% WR DvP, Texans 7th-most implied pts). McConkey LP-DNP-LP foot after prior rib.
items.why: Player-specific data on DvP, practice, implied totals, prior injuries.
items.implication: Collins strong start; Nacua monitor volume; McConkey risky Q.
items.opportunity: Collins routes/targets vs softest WR defense; Nacua potential limited snaps

items.text: Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out. Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun vs Rams.
items.why: Jefferson absence creates clear opportunity; Eagles missing three key players.
items.implication: Addison start/upgrade; Eagles offense and remaining skill fade.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL) along with Caleb Douglas; Miami backfield fully reshuffled.
items.why: ETR OUT list; reports confirm torn ACL IR.
items.implication: Permanent loss; long-term handcuff/waiver elevation for remaining MIA RBs.
items.opportunity: MIA RB snaps/carries fully redistributed ROS

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest) with Zach Charbonnet also out; SEA RB role eroded already by fumbles/GL loss.
items.why: ETR list; Levitan notes chest + prior role losses to Wilson/Holani + Charbonnet practice.
items.implication: Further short-term demotion; longer-term still viable if recovers role.
items.opportunity: Other SEA RBs (Wilson/Holani) temporary carries/GL/pass-down work

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game. Top-10 play.
items.opportunity: Near-full snap/carry share vs soft run D

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, RB5 util, NYG soft run D + targets); Drake London (35%+ TS w/ Penix, 9-194 last); Garrett Wilson (36% TS w/o Mitchell, CHI soft).
items.why: High utilization, QB stability, matchup data.
items.opportunity: Love touches/targets; London target share; Wilson volume w/ Mitchell out

items.text: Price tough early: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing. Still eye-test positive long-term.
items.why: Specific role losses + injury + competition returning.
items.implication: Short-term fade/sit; hold for long-term if role rebounds.
items.opportunity: Reduced GL/pass-down/base snaps already before OUT

items.text: Judkins 13.8% target share with Sampson out (vs 8.3% prior); on pace 64 catches after 26 last year.
items.why: Target share jump in limited sample without teammate.
items.implication: Pass-game RB upside elevated; deeper league start/flex consideration.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low 42% snaps/3.5% TS/13% 3rd down, SEA stout vs run); Justin Herbert (high pressure, SEA elite pass D, low implied); Emeka Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total).
items.why: Poor recent usage metrics + tough matchups/implied totals.
items.opportunity: Hampton limited snaps/routes; Herbert efficiency risk
